notes: West Bengal usage: "টিপুন" for press, class numbers said as English words in Bengali script ("ক্লাস সেভেন"), dates in the date forms (পয়লা, দোসরা, দশই, উনিশে).
Times are the locative clock forms (দশটায়, সাড়ে দশটায়, দেড়টায়, আড়াইটায়), so the template adds no postposition after {time}.
The school name is followed by থেকে, never a genitive, so any school name works without inflecting it.
names.venues are plain nouns; the locative (হলে, মাঠে, লাইব্রেরিতে) is formed from lexicon.locative.
names.closureReasons are genitive, because the template says "{reason} জন্য".
charsPerSecond is the slowest message+menu rate measured by scripts/sampark/verify-voice.ts on 2026-09-30 with the live voice and style prompt (conservative, so the 38 s budget warning fires early).
Short clips do not open with "ধন্যবাদ": the word is identical in Hindi, and the recogniser then transcribed a 4-second Bengali clip as Hindi. Thanks go last.

common.opt_out_done: ধন্যবাদ। আপনাকে আর এই ধরনের কল করা হবে না। স্কুল বন্ধের জরুরি খবর তবুও পৌঁছবে।
